meta.question: on cub_lt K=29, does unit-norm rescaling of each class row of the student head (tau-normalisation, no fitting) remove the tail-accuracy gap between methods, i.e. is the head gap a weight-norm gap?
meta.method: tau-normalised classifier (tau=1, bias dropped); per-class weight norm ratio tail/head; cosine of class weight to centred val class-mean feature; spread of method means; Spearman with run bootstrap; paired t CI
